comment.body:
This PR now has more than one publisher startup/failure orchestration path.

Simple apps use `AbcvlibActivity.startPublishersWithFailureHandling(...)`, while `basicAssembler` reaches publisher startup through `Trial.startTrail()`, which separately handles success/failure/retry via `PublisherManager.startPublishers(::onPublisherStartupResult)`.

That is functional, but it means the startup/retry/failure flow is split across activity and trial code. This seems like another signal that the common publisher startup orchestration should live closer to the publisher layer, with activity/trial/app code only supplying UI or app-specific callbacks.
